title: Ko Olina Ocean Adventures
specs: Ko Olina Ocean Adventures, Inc. must be notified of any change requests via email or phone at least 24 hours prior to scheduled check in time.

The Speedboat Dolphin Snorkel Tour includes a passive dolphin swim Hawaii with the friendly wild spinner dolphins, followed by a reef snorkel loaded with brilliantly colored tropical fish and a variety of pacific ocean life.
Your dolphin swim Oahu encounter tour concludes with a snorkel at “Turtle Town” with the calm Hawaiian green sea turtles.
Your swim with dolphins Hawaii also includes seasonal whale watching.

Ko Olina Ocean Adventures, Oahu’s best and most popular Hawaii dolphin swim tour, and Paradise Cove Luau, Oahu’s best and most popular luau, near Disney Aulani, now offer an exclusive Snorkel by Day and Luau by Night Combo Savings Package.
